title: Identity-normalized restricted Hom equivalences
statement: theorem perfect_hom_open_restricted_pinned_equiv {I : Type u} [Preorder I] (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (c : Cocone R) {i : I} {Y : Scheme.{u}} (s : Y ⟶ Spec (R.obj i)) [∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))] (B : Y.Opens) (a : derivedPullback B.ι ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage B.ι) (Q : schemeDerivedCategory Y) (F : Set.Ici i ⥤ schemeDerivedCategory Y) (d : Cocone F) (h : PerfectHomPushPullData R c s Q F d) : ∃ e : PerfectHomOpenRestrictedEquivFields R c s B Q F d, (∀ j : Set.Ici i, e.stageEquiv j ((schemeMVDerivedRestriction Y B).obj (F.obj j)) (𝟙 _) = perfectHomOpenRestrictionMap s B (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.property))) a (h.stageEquiv j (F.obj j) (𝟙 _))) ∧ (e.limitEquiv ((schemeMVDerivedRestriction Y B).obj d.pt) (𝟙 _) = perfectHomOpenRestrictionMap s B (Spec.map (c.ι.app i)) a (h.limitEquiv d.pt (𝟙 _)))

source.place: Tags 079W and 08FE; perfect.tex Tag 09RE, restriction to inverse-image opens in the Hom comparison

proof.text: For each test N on B, choose its supported extension X(N), its restriction isomorphism t, and the unique inverse of restriction on Hom out of X(N). Localizations on over-modules are supplied in the ambient Hom universe.

Compose the supported Hom lifting equivalence with the original representing equivalence, bijective cartesian pullback Hom restriction, and precomposition by pullback(t.hom). Testing-object naturality follows from injectivity of the lift and naturality of conjugation.

At LM, lift its identity to x:X(LM) → M, so Lx=t.inv. The lift of Lf is x followed by f. Naturality of the original equivalence and restriction map gives pullback(t.hom) followed by pullback(t.inv) followed by the restriction of the old value. Cancel the inverse pair. Apply to every stage and the apex; package the equivalence and naturality fields and specialize to identities.
